app.noReadings: This session has no readings for this.
app.dropSide: Drag more .TLM files onto this column. They are read in your browser and never uploaded.
app.closedAll: {n, plural, one {# file closed.} other {# files closed.}}
app.loadingLarge: Large files take a few seconds. The file stays in your browser.
app.loadingLocal: The file stays in your browser.
app.unsupported: {name} is not a supported log file.
app.offlineText: No internet connection. Opening and analysing logs still works; only the map needs internet.
app.feedbackStart: Your transmitter or sensor not working?
app.updateReady: A new version of TLMscope is ready.
app.tooLarge: {name} is larger than {max} MB and was not opened. Telemetry logs are usually a few MB.
app.replaced: {name} was already open and has been replaced by the file you just added.
app.viewError: This view could not be shown.
app.viewErrorText: Your files are still open. Try another session or tab, or try again.
app.nameFromFile: model name from the file name
app.total: {time} in {n, plural, one {# flight} other {# flights}}
app.totalHint: Only the files loaded now are counted: time in the air, without pauses on the ground. A session found in two copies of a log counts once.
app.simTotalHint: Time in a flight simulator through a dongle, counted apart from the time in the air: only the time with the sticks moved, without pauses in menus. Only the files loaded now are counted.
app.totalHintApprox: Part of the time is estimated from motor and movement, because those flights have no height or GPS data.
app.exportCsvHint: Saves the sessions shown in the list as a spreadsheet file. Nothing is sent anywhere.
app.movedSettings: Settings saved at this address (units, battery names, map options) do not move along: please set them again there.
app.simulatorText: The transmitter flew a flight simulator through a simulator dongle (such as the Spektrum WS3000). No data came from a model, so there are no flight, battery or link values.
app.transmitterOnlyText: The transmitter was switched on with this model selected, but no receiver data arrived. Usually this means the model was not powered.
app.missingNeeds: Not available: this log has no {channels}.
app.demoBanner: Demo data: this flight is synthetic, made to show every view.

overview.groundSummary: Ground test of {time}. The motor ran for {secs} s and drew up to {amps} A.
overview.poweredSummary: The model was switched on for {time} without running the motor.
overview.flightAir: {minutes} minutes in the air, up to {height}.
overview.noHeight: No height sensor data in this session: height, climbs and lift are not available. The time in the air comes from the GPS speed or from the model's movement.
overview.gpsHeight: Height from GPS: there is no height sensor, so the height above ground comes from the GPS altitude. It is less exact (about ±5–10 m), so climbs, lift and gliding are not shown. The time in the air comes from the GPS speed.
overview.flightMotor: The motor ran {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} for {time} min in total.
overview.flightLift: You found lift {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} and gained {gain} without motor.
overview.climbs: {n, plural, one {# motor run} other {# motor runs}}
overview.healthHint: Every rating uses the same four steps.
overview.momentsHint: Click a moment to see it in the charts.

rating.linkHint: How reliably commands reached the model.
rating.linkHintAir: How reliably commands reached the model in the air.
rating.linkHoldHint: The receiver lost the link for half a second or longer (45 frames in a row) and went to failsafe.
rating.linkHoldEstimated: Without height or GPS data, the flight time is estimated from the motor and the model's movement.
rating.moveAntenna: far above the other remote receivers: move it
rating.signalHint: Strength of the transmitter signal at the receiver.
rating.signalHintAir: Strength of the transmitter signal at the receiver, in the air.
rating.signalWeakShare: Weak or worse {pct} % of the time.
rating.levelsSignal: ≥ −70 high · ≥ −80 normal · ≥ −85 weak (from the sample flights; other receivers may read differently)
rating.usedHint: {used} of {capacity} mAh{source}, drawn by the motor. Rule of thumb: stay below 80 %.
rating.usedNoCapacity: {used} mAh. The battery did not report its capacity. Enter it under <capacityLink>Motor & energy</capacityLink> to see the share.
rating.conditionHint: How much the voltage drops under load. A tired pack drops more.
rating.conditionFrozen: Battery data stuck, see the data check.
rating.conditionNone: Not enough motor use to judge.
rating.resistance: Internal resistance per cell (estimate, incl. wiring)
rating.tempsHint: The warmer of motor controller and battery.
rating.rxHint: Voltage for receiver and servos, without the moments of switching on and off.
rating.styleHint: Strongest acceleration felt by the model. Not a quality rating.
rating.styleHintAir: Strongest acceleration in the air, without launch and touchdown. Not a quality rating.
rating.dataOkHint: No stuck or missing sensors found.
rating.dataBad: Some readings in this session look wrong.
rating.efficiencyHint: Height gained per battery charge, compared with your other flights of this model in the loaded files.
rating.consumptionHint: Charge used per minute in the air, compared with your other flights of this model in the loaded files.

issue.frozenText: These values did not change for the whole session although the motor drew up to {amps} A: {values}. The readings are not trustworthy.
issue.battery-not-reportingText: No smart-battery data in this session. Battery charge is estimated from the motor controller instead.
issue.no-cell-voltagesText: The battery identified itself but never sent individual cell voltages.
issue.height-flatText: The height sensor sent the same value for the whole flight. Height, climbs and lift are not available; the time in the air comes from GPS or from the model's movement.

height.title: What happened in the air
height.hint: Phases are detected automatically from motor use and climb rate.
height.climbHint: Above +{v} with the motor off counts as lift.
height.notGliding: sinking {rate}: dives and figures rather than a glide, so no glide values
height.noLift: No lift found in this flight: after the motor stopped, the model never climbed on its own for 10 s or more. Lift phases would appear in green.
height.sinkNote: Glide sink rate comes straight from the vario: the model's own sinking speed plus any rising or sinking air. Over many flights the typical value approximates your model's sink rate. A true glide ratio needs an airspeed or GPS sensor.
height.noFlight: No flight in this session, so there is no height profile.

path.linkChart: Radio link · signal (dBm) and frame losses
path.linkChartLosses: Radio link · frame losses per second
path.lossMarks: {n, plural, one {# second with frame losses} other {# seconds with frame losses}}
path.lossesAt: {n, plural, one {# frame loss} other {# frame losses}}
path.linkMarksHint: Dots on the path: frame losses (orange) and holds (red). Click a dot to jump to that moment.
path.noLinkEvents: No frame losses or holds in this flight.
path.placeOrAttitude: A weak spot can lie in the place or in the model's attitude there (tail towards you, banked). Only when it comes back in other flights does it most likely lie in the place.
path.title: Flight path
path.noGpsTitle: No GPS in this log, so no map
path.noGpsText: Map, distance and speed need a GPS sensor. Without one we only know the height, not where the model was. A path guessed from the rotation sensors would drift by tens of metres within seconds, so it is not shown.
path.rotationTitle: What the rotation sensors can tell
path.periods: {n, plural, one {# circling period} other {# circling periods}}
path.directionNote: Left or right is not yet verified for this receiver installation.
path.circlingNote: Circles are counted from the pitch and yaw rotation sensors, which together measure how fast the model turns. Circling while climbing with the motor off is the classic sign of a thermal.
path.shadowHint: The path projected onto the ground, to see where the model was over the terrain.
path.follow: Height · move here to follow the model
path.followThrottle: Throttle · move here to follow the model
path.groundSpeedHint: Speed over the ground from GPS: lower against the wind, higher with it.
path.zoomCtrl: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
path.zoomCmd: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
path.twoFingers: Use two fingers to move the map
path.mapOffline: You are offline. The map needs an internet connection. Everything else on this page works.
path.gpsNote: Distances and speeds count only the time in the air.
path.gpsJumps: {n, plural, one {One implausible GPS jump was left out.} other {# implausible GPS jumps were left out.}}
path.reliefHint: Experimental: shows the terrain in 3D, with shading, from free elevation data. Loads extra map data from Amazon Web Services; see the privacy notice.
path.shadowRelief: Not available while the relief is on.
path.chaseHint: Experimental: the camera follows the model and the replay starts at once. Switches the relief on, which loads extra map data from Amazon Web Services; see the privacy notice.
path.mapFailed: The map could not be loaded. It needs an internet connection and a browser with WebGL.
path.pathModeHint: During the replay, show the whole path or only the part flown so far. Before the replay starts the whole path is shown.

energy.rpmHint: Divide by half the motor's pole count for shaft rpm.
energy.powerHint: Input voltage × current at the motor controller. What reaches the propeller is less: the controller and the motor lose part of it.
energy.note: A climb that ends in a turn or a dive shows lower efficiency even with the same motor and propeller.
energy.needsOtherFlights: Rated against at least {min} other flights of this model. Loaded so far: {n}.
energy.usedText: {used} of {capacity} mAh used by the motor.

capacity.title: Battery capacity
capacity.hint: This battery did not report its capacity. Enter it to see how much of the pack was used. It is saved in this browser for this model.
capacity.savedHint: Using the {mah} mAh you entered for this model. It is saved in this browser.
capacity.defaultHint: Using your default of {mah} mAh. Enter a capacity to use for this model only.
capacity.label: Capacity for {model}
capacity.invalid: Enter a value between 50 and 100000 mAh.

battery.noIdentity: Smart batteries report their own ID. This one did not, or it is not a smart battery.
battery.chargeHint: At start and end, from the resting voltage.
battery.endUnderLoad: Not measured: the log ends with the motor running
battery.voltage: Battery voltage (per cell, from motor controller)
battery.voltageHint: Dips are the motor pulling current. Shaded: below 3.7 V and 3.5 V per cell.
battery.name: Battery {letter}

link.filter: Click a level to show only it, and step through it with the arrows.
link.overTimeHint: Green is good. Yellow and red show where the link got weak.
link.note: Without GPS, height is the only distance hint: higher usually means farther away.
link.fadesHint: A is the main receiver, B, L and R are remote receivers. One receiver fading much more than the others points to its antenna or where it sits in the model.
link.distanceHint: The signal normally gets weaker with distance. Weak dots at short range are the ones to look at: the model's attitude, shadowing or interference. Where they were shows on the map (colour by signal).

spot.losses: most frame losses at {at}, {value} in one second

aircraft.notReportedHint: The receiver sends no flight mode, so the log says nothing about AS3X or SAFE.

raw.title: Sensors in this session
raw.hint: Click a row for fields and raw packets.
raw.headersHint: Model name and enabled sensors as stored by the transmitter. Bytes after the sensor pair look like alarm settings (unverified).
raw.channelsHint: Every canonical channel in this session, with its source and sample count.

batteries.title: Batteries
batteries.hint: Smart batteries report their own ID and charge cycles, so every session can be linked to the pack that powered it.
batteries.naming: Batteries are named A, B, … in order of first use in the loaded files. Give them your own names, ideally the one written on the pack: names stay with the battery's ID in every file.
batteries.stuckHint: Sent frozen cell voltages at least once. Possibly a faulty pack.
batteries.partialHint: Identifies itself but never sends cell voltages.
batteries.unknownHint: No smart-battery data. Possibly a pack that stopped reporting, or a battery without telemetry.
batteries.none: No smart batteries in the loaded files.
batteries.note: Condition compares the voltage drop under load between flights. A pack whose drop keeps growing is wearing out.
batteries.ageingNote: internal resistance per cell, one dot per flight
batteries.ageingNotEnough: A trend needs at least 5 flights over 2 weeks. So far: {points, plural, one {# flight} other {# flights}} over {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
batteries.ageingRetire: Has reached the retire level of 15 mΩ per cell.
batteries.ageingForecast: Reaches the retire level of 15 mΩ per cell in about {n} charge cycles at this rate.
batteries.ageingStable: No wear worth noting: the resistance is not heading for the retire level.
batteries.ageingNow: Now {now} mΩ per cell, {change} mΩ per 10 charge cycles (trend over the last 10 flights).
batteries.ageingCold: Hollow dots are flights below {t}. Cold packs read high, so they are left out of the trend.
batteries.noneForModel: No smart batteries in the flights of this model.
batteries.namingGrouped: Batteries are named A, B, … in order of first use in the loaded files, and listed under the model each flew most often. Give them your own names, ideally the one written on the pack: names stay with the battery's ID in every file.

inv.title: Data inventory
inv.hint: Everything found in the loaded files, including the parts that are not understood yet.
inv.kinds: {flight} flights · {ground} ground tests · {power} powered on · {tx} transmitter only · {sim} simulator
inv.gpsHint: A GPS sensor adds map, distance and speed

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Tell me what is wrong, missing or unclear, or what you like. I read every message.
feedback.contextCheck: Send these details with my message
feedback.ctxWhere: Where you are in the app
feedback.ctxSensors: Sensor types in your files (codes only)
feedback.notSent: Never sent: log files, file names, model names, positions, battery IDs or flight values.
feedback.tally: The form is provided by Tally (Belgium). It loads when you continue, and Tally then receives your IP address and what you type.
feedback.contextOn: The details above are sent with your message.
feedback.contextOff: No details are sent with your message.
feedback.logsNote: Want to share a log? Reply to my answer by email. Logs with GPS show where you fly.
feedback.offline: Feedback needs an internet connection. Please try again when you are online.

whatsNew.title: Highlights
whatsNew.unseen: new highlights since your last look

footer.offlineHint: TLMscope is stored in this browser and opens without internet. Map images still need a connection.

thermals.title: Thermals
thermals.summary: {n, plural, one {One thermal} other {# thermals}}: +{gain} in {time} min without motor.
thermals.circles: {n, plural, one {# full circle} other {# full circles}}, {secs} s each.
thermals.saved: Saved about {secs} s of motor ({mah} mAh).
thermals.perCircleHint: The small bars show the height gained in each circle. Even bars mean the core was well centred; drift shows where the wind carried the thermal.
thermals.savedHint: “Saved” is the motor time and charge the same height would have cost at this flight's motor climbs.
thermals.mapLegend: Green dots: thermal centres of all loaded flights near this field. Bigger means stronger, outlined means this flight.

replay.title: Replay
replay.hint: The map marker and every chart follow. Space starts and stops.
replay.hintNoMap: Every chart follows. Space starts and stops.

minmax.title: Lowest and highest values
minmax.hint: Like the min/max screen on the transmitter. Counters show their total. Click a value to see that moment in the charts.

settings.title: My settings
settings.intro: These settings apply to everything you open in TLMscope.
settings.batteriesHint: Spektrum Smart batteries report their capacity. For other batteries, enter it so TLMscope can show how much of the pack was used. You can enter a capacity per model under <capacityLink>Motor & energy</capacityLink>.
settings.invalid: Enter a value between 50 and 100000 mAh, or leave the field empty.
settings.noCapacities: No capacities entered for single models yet.
settings.batteryNamesHint: Your names for smart batteries. Name a battery on the Batteries page.
settings.local: Settings are saved in this browser only. They never leave your device.

more.minMax: the lowest and highest value of every sensor
more.raw: the raw data tab with every decoded sensor stream
more.climbPerPhase: the climb rate of each phase
more.perMah: {unit} gained per 100 mAh for each climb
more.batteryId: the battery ID and its voltage limits
more.balance: how evenly the cells are balanced
more.best10s: the best 10 seconds of each thermal
more.distance: the distance from the start over time
more.dbmMap: the signal in dBm on the map
more.ageingNow: the current internal resistance and its change per 10 cycles
more.cellVolts: start and end voltage per cell

logbook.title: My logbook
logbook.settingsHint: Adds up your flight time and simulator time over every file you open, not only the files open now. It is off unless you switch it on: then TLMscope keeps one short entry per flight or simulator session (start, length, model, time, file name) in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
logbook.earlier: Files you opened before count once you open them again.
logbook.browserOnly: The logbook lives in this browser only. Some browsers (Safari) delete it after a few weeks without a visit, so save a backup now and then.
logbook.stopQuestion: Recording is off. Delete the stored logbook ({n, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}) or keep it?
logbook.simSub: {n, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}, sticks moved · connected {time}
logbook.modelsHint: Switch off models that are logs of other pilots: they are left out and not recorded any more.
logbook.filesHint: Switch off a file from another pilot whose model has the same name as one of yours.
logbook.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Open your .TLM files: the flights and simulator sessions of your models are added.
logbook.recordingOff: Recording is off: the stored logbook is shown, nothing new is added. You can switch it on in the settings.
logbook.restored: {n, plural, =0 {Backup loaded, no new sessions in it.} one {Backup loaded: # session added.} other {Backup loaded: # sessions added.}}
logbook.notBackup: This file is not a TLMscope logbook backup.
logbook.clearQuestion: {n, plural, one {Delete the stored session?} other {Delete all # stored sessions?}} This cannot be undone.
logbook.local: Kept in this browser only, nothing is uploaded. The backup and the CSV file are made in your browser.
logbook.askModel: My logbook: count the sessions of {name}?
logbook.hint: Add up over all your files?
logbook.writeFailed: The logbook could not be saved: the browser refused (storage full or blocked).
logbook.startLine: My logbook: {air} in the air · {sim} simulator
